provenance.rule: Values are copied from dated repository records or the September 2026 live audit. Missing observations are not imputed.

deployment_snapshot.stamp_service_account_gap: The shared stamp pod automounts the agent service-account token into agent, data-plane, and collector containers.

kernel_microbenchmark.evidence: immutable development artifact; not production or T4 evidence

cost_scenarios.evidence: derived from the 18 Sep Azure retail-price estimate; not invoices
cost_scenarios.current_five_node_caveat: The five-node point reuses the earlier non-GPU fixed-cost assumption although PostgreSQL was later observed on a different SKU.

t4_startup_stages.evidence: retained Kubernetes events and container logs for one Qwen3.5-0.8B model host on an AKS T4 node (docs/model-startup-diagnosis.md); stage boundaries are the recorded UTC timestamps
t4_startup_stages.serving_settings: FP16, context 4096, max-num-seqs 8, gpu-memory-utilization 0.85, eager execution, vLLM 0.26.0

t4_text_only_validation.evidence: isolated validation Job on a spare T4 (docs/model-startup-diagnosis.md); node caches and CPU reservations differed from the retained run, so the difference is not an isolated speedup

routing_benchmark.evidence: simulated model hosts behind the production gateway; citable_as_hardware_measurement is false in every artifact
routing_benchmark.host_model: 4 backends; 2048 blocks x 16 tokens of LRU prefix cache per host; prefill 0.25 ms per uncached token plus 5 ms; decode 16 ms plus 1 ms per running sequence; at most 16 running sequences; time scale 0.25
routing_benchmark.note: Figures read results.json in each sweep directory directly and aggregate per-seed summaries exactly as data-plane/benchmarks/routing/report.py does (arithmetic mean over seeds).

rtx_pro_6000_stamp.enrollment: one-command bootstrap on a single GPU VM running k3s

tool_call_parser_incident.symptom: HTTP 400 on tool-calling requests until a tool-call parser preset was added

live_observations_2026_11_17_tpu.vm: single-host Cloud TPU v6e-1 VM (machine type ct6e-standard-1t): 1 chip, 32 GiB HBM
live_observations_2026_11_17_tpu.bootstrap: one-command bootstrap detected the TPU from the GCP metadata accelerator-type
live_observations_2026_11_17_tpu.agent_measured: 1 x TPU v6e reported by the stamp agent
live_observations_2026_11_17_tpu.placement: a deployment was placed on the TPU stamp

defects.symptom: the only catalog TPU preset asked for 4 chips, so a v6e-1 stamp was never offered as a placement
defects.fix: single-chip preset: Qwen3.5 4B bf16 on class tpu-v6e with 1 chip per replica

defects.symptom: libtpu failed at model-host start: TPU initialization failed: Failed to connect to [::]:8353
defects.cause: libtpu reaches its local runtime service over IPv6 loopback, which the IPv4-only pod network lacks
defects.fix: TPU model hosts run with hostNetwork and ClusterFirstWithHostNet DNS; GPU hosts keep the pod network

routing_policy_split_check.scope: deterministic computation with the shipped routing-policy module; not a measurement
routing_policy_split_check.source: python3 paper/policy_split_check.py at commit 948e673 (choose_target over keys key-0 .. key-99999)
